usedFor: Givebutter holds fundraising campaigns and donations, and Instagram for Business shows them when “Publish Instagram Story” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Givebutter, then “Publish Instagram Story” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A new campaign is worth announcing, and the action posts a photo or video from a public URL.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” needs a public URL for the photo or video, so the media must be reachable.
